content:
Maya: Quick flag 02:37 UTC we saw intermittent failures in the indexing pipeline for a subset of documents during onboarding batches. Affected tenants so far: Trial-ACME, RetailPilot-42, EduBeta-9, HealthTest-7. Putting together comms & remediation plan. @Oliver any status?

Oliver: Confirmed. We detected a regression after the q8 encoder rollout causing malformed token boundaries on certain payloads. Rolled the encoder back in us-east and eu; ap-south rolling now. Health checks green in rolled regions.

deploy-bot: rollback job initiated: deploy/encoder-rollback-180111 -> in progress

Oliver: Rollback command we ran:
```
kubectl -n inference set image encoder=registry.redwood/encoder:v1-20260322
```
Health probes returned 200 within 90s after the flip. We also kicked a retry job for pending writes; monitoring queue drain.

Maya: Thanks. Nina, JC 50:50 can we coordinate external comms? Need standard note for trials and a stronger offer for accounts in renewal.

Nina (CS): Yeah. For renewal-risk accounts (RetailPilot-42) suggest 1 month premium support + named AE meeting. For trials, offer a 60-min onboarding recovery session + 5% credit. We'll schedule recovery office hours for immediate triage.

JC (AE): RetailPilot-42 renewal next week 51:05 - escalate. Also request a billing tag so finance can track credits: "incident-credit-1821112222". I'll DM Maya the exact concession wording.

Maya: Draft standard outbound (short):
"Hi <Customer>, we identified intermittent indexing delays between 02:3002:45 UTC that may have prevented some uploads from completing. We reverted a recent encoder change and retried pending items; you should see them finish within the hour. We're sorry for the interruption. We'd like to offer a complimentary 60-minute onboarding recovery session and a one-time 5% credit for this billing month. If you still see missing items, reply and we'll prioritize manual re-ingest. Office hours: Tue 10am PT / Wed 3pm CET / Fri 9am IST."

Maya: Draft high-touch outbound (RetailPilot-42):
"Hi <Name>, apologies for the disruption during indexing on <date>. We reverted the change, retried your pending items, and will prioritize any remaining uploads. To make this right, we'd like to offer one month of premium support at no charge, a 1:1 enablement session, and direct AE contact (JC). Please let us know a good time and we'll schedule immediately."

Nina (CS): Good. Keep ML details out of customer-facing text. Internally include root cause: quantization regression causing tokenization drift for edge payloads. External: "an internal change caused failures for a subset of documents; we reverted the change and retried your items."

Oliver: Agree on wording. Internally we'll add a unit test for tokenization edge cases and gate future encoder rollouts with a shadow validation step.

deploy-bot: incident ticket created: INC-2026-084. RCA placeholder: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-084

Maya: Plan: 1) Send high-touch messages now for renewal customers. 2) Send standard template to trials in 15m. 3) Open office hours booking and include booking link in messages. I'll include the finance billing tag.

JC (AE): DM sent to Maya with RetailPilot concession and agreement to be CC'd on the high-touch note. Also requested phone contact line for that account.

Nina (CS): I'll prepare a short CS playbook to track responses and manual re-ingest requests. We'll capture feedback in the office hours and attach notes to the RCA.

Oliver: After the queue drains I'll push a brief postmortem summary with diff and test plan. Also recommend we add a canary rollout step for quantized encoder changes.

Maya: Sending high-touch now. Will post standard broadcast in 15m and update execs + ops by EOD. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
